author: Shopify Blazor Toolkit contributors
name: Shopify embedded app (Blazor Web App, Interactive Server)
description: An embedded Shopify admin app: a Blazor Web App with Interactive Server, Shopify's own Polaris web components, App Bridge 4, and a verified session-token authentication path.

Framework.description: The target framework for the project.

choices.description: The only framework the toolkit supports. See ADR 0001.

include-sample-pages.description: Include the sample pages: a products list that calls the Admin API, and a gallery of every Polaris component the toolkit wraps.

include-admin-api-example.description: Include the authenticated /api/products endpoint, its service, and the browser module that calls it.

toolkitVersion.description: Version of the Polaris.Blazor and Shopify.Blazor packages to reference. Point this at a locally packed version to try an unpublished build.
